findings.title: Silence menu item does nothing in the new list
findings.body: With only `promRule`, AlertRuleMenu now shows "Silence notifications" because `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` grants Silence (useAbilities.ts:323). The drawer, though, only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. `rule` is undefined for every item that GrafanaRuleListItem renders (GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:47), so clicking the item sets state and nothing shows up. SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer needs only the uid (SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer.tsx:21). Pass a uid from `promRule` when it is a Grafana alerting rule.

findings.title: Pause and Delete are gone from the Grafana rule list
findings.body: `canPause` and `canDelete` can now come true from the prom-rule abilities. The menu items still require a ruler rule, though: `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` at line 123 and `canDelete && rulerRule` at line 165. GrafanaRuleListItem no longer passes `rule`, so the list view (group view and filter view) lost Pause and Delete for every Grafana-managed rule. Before this change it passed `rulerRule` and showed both. The updated test codifies this: it expects exactly 4 menu items (GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx:207). Either support these actions with a uid or identifier, or say in the PR that dropping them is intended.

findings.title: `key` dropped from GrafanaRuleListItem inside rules.map
findings.body: The old `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} …>` had a key. The replacement has none, while the datasource and unknown branches still pass `key={key}`. React will warn, and it will reconcile by index as the filter results stream in and change. Per-item state such as the open silence drawer or the clone redirect can then attach to the wrong rule. Add `key={key}`.

findings.title: Rule view link no longer carries returnTo
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleListItem built `href` with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new one drops `returnTo`, so after opening a rule from a filtered or grouped list, the viewer's back navigation no longer returns to the list with its filters. Restore the `returnTo` param.

findings.title: Prom-rule abilities exclude Grafana recording rules from Export/Pause/Restore
findings.body: The ruler variant gated ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule` (alerting or recording). The new variant uses `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule`, so Grafana recording rules lose Export in the list view. The comment at line 301 says "All GrafanaPromRuleDTO rules are Grafana-managed", which suggests `isGrafanaManaged = true` was the intent here.

findings.title: Permission-denied test does not exercise the prom-rule permission path
findings.body: It sets folder access control to false only for update and delete, and then asserts just that Edit is absent. No test checks that Pause, Delete or Silence work from the list. That gap is how the regressions above slip through while the 4-item assertion passes.

contracts.action: List item actions built from promRule only (no ruler request)
contracts.equivalent_path: Removed GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx GrafanaRuleListItem passed rule={rulerRule} promRule={rule}
contracts.before_after: Before: ruler rule available, so Pause, Delete and the Silence drawer all worked. After: rule is undefined, so Pause and Delete are hidden and the Silence drawer is gated on the ruler rule.
contracts.visible_effect: Menu shows Silence, Duplicate, Copy link and Export. Silence does nothing. Pause and Delete are missing.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent: no error is shown when the Silence click does nothing.

contracts.before_after: The backend prom API exposes provenance (omitempty).
contracts.visible_effect: Provisioned badge and immutability work in the list.

summary: The list view now drops the ruler API and builds rule actions from the Prometheus rule alone, but AlertRuleMenu and RuleActionsButtons.V2 still need a ruler rule for several actions. As a result Pause and Delete disappear from the Grafana rule list, and the Silence item shows up but does nothing. Two smaller regressions: FilterView no longer gives Grafana items a React key, and the rule view link no longer carries returnTo.
